what: A MicroFreak-style paraphonic synth for the FM-1: digital oscillator engines, a ladder filter, two LFOs, a mod matrix, an arpeggiator and sequencer with Chance and Impress, FX and a stereo widener.
author: Guilherme Ruppert
sounds: CC0: Versilian Studios VSCO-2 CE and VCSL (piano, flute, sax samples kept in the repository from Felucca; the Nano Freak sound engine is all synthesised)
